decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be used any time other than as part of the existing ground floor flat use as a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the ground floor flat.

Condition : 5 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Enlargement of existing cellar to provide habitable space, lowering of existing ground floor courtyard to basement level and formation of lightwells to front and rear elevation.
